facts.business: Eris Lifesciences Limited is an Indian pharmaceutical company focused on diabetes care, insulins, GLP-1 analogs, and other chronic therapies, with in-house manufacturing capabilities.

capacity_or_capex.timeline: H2 FY27 for Semaglutide vials and cartridges

guidance_or_targets.statement: Expect to be a strategically important player in the Indian insulin market
In-house manufacturing of Semaglutide vials and cartridges to commence

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key Audit Matter: Revenue Recognition due to volume of sales contracts, varied terms, complex accruals for discounts/returns, and risk of overstatement

key_risks: Revenue recognition risk due to large number of sales contracts with varied terms and complex accruals for discounts, returns, and price adjustments
Dependence on diabetes/insulin franchise for growth
Execution risk on new product launches (Degludec, Aspart, Semaglutide manufacturing)
Competition from innovators and other Indian companies in insulin market
facts.related_party_note: Pledged equity shares with debenture trustees as security for NCDs of Rs 437.50 crore issued to erstwhile shareholders of SPL; NCDs fully redeemed in previous financial year and pledge released in current financial year
